q2_gaps: a past-tense habitual/iterative clause ("walked the Cove Stair every evening"): the frequency section says the event stays unmarked ("no Past/Ongoing - habitual") while the tense rule marks every finite past clause with (Past e), and the instruction set never says which governs a past habitual

distribution of a counted comitative group ("with three Keepers") to its members: the per-member (PartOf $x <group>) rule is specified for a group that is the clause's subject / predicated participant, not for a CoAgent filler, so whether each Keeper's own walking is derivable is unaddressed
